StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack (powers.py:64-66) adds unconditionally, which is exactly what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236 -- no StackType branch). StackType's only non-presentation readers are GetTypeForAmount (PowerModel.cs:462) and InvokePowerModified's VFX split (Creature.cs:628). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AmountLabelColor.rationale: PoisonPower.cs:23 forces the normal (cream) label colour instead of the debuff red. Presentation.

AfterSideTurnStart.issue: Three divergences, all DORMANT for one shared reason: **nothing in the sim applies Poison at all.** An executed grep for PoisonPower outside powers.py and the package re-exports returns no applier -- no card, relic, event, monster or potion. (a) SLOT: The sim's on_player_turn_start (player.py:169) fires BEFORE the hand draw (player.py:171-186), where C#'s AfterSideTurnStart is dispatched at CombatManager.cs:522, AFTER SetupPlayerTurn (:514) has reset energy and drawn the hand. The sim's matching post-draw slot is on_player_turn_started (player.py:186). EXECUTED: a spy listener records [on_player_turn_start hand=5, 4x on_card_drawn, on_player_turn_started hand=9]. Third-file citations, not hashed here. EXECUTED -- with Poison 5 on the player a spy records ['hp-5', 'draw', 'draw', 'draw', 'draw'], i.e. the tick lands before the hand draw, where PoisonPower.cs:55 runs at CombatManager.cs:522 after it. That is conformance-visible even when nothing dies, because a lethal tick would cancel a draw the game already made. (b) TRIGGER COUNT: C# loops `TriggerCount` times (PoisonPower.cs:31-40,61-73), which is `min(Amount, 1 + the sum of AccelerantPower across living opponents)`; the sim always fires exactly once. AccelerantPower is unported, so per binding rule 1 this is a dormant gap rather than a waiver; named trigger = porting Accelerant. (c) DECREMENT GUARD: C# decrements only `if (Owner.IsAlive)` (PoisonPower.cs:65-68) whereas powers.py:482 always ticks; conversely the sim adds an entry guard C# does not have (`if self.owner.is_dead: return`, powers.py:474-475). Named trigger for the whole unit: porting any Poison source.

guards.rationale: The sim's two legs self-filter to the owner instead (powers.py:485, :489). The per-creature-vs-per-side problem is recorded on the AfterSideTurnStart entry, not here.
powers.py:480 passes DamageProps.NON_CARD_HP_LOSS, which is exactly UNBLOCKABLE | UNPOWERED (valueprops.py:44-45). Also matches on dealer and cardSource: C# passes null for both, the sim omits both.

guards.what: PoisonPower.cs:64 the damage amount is Amount, re-read each iteration
guards.rationale: With one iteration the sim's single `self.amount` read (powers.py:479) is equivalent. Note C#'s CalculateTotalDamageNextTurn (:42-53) uses `Amount - i` for the PREVIEW while the loop itself uses the live post-Decrement Amount -- a preview-only asymmetry the sim has no counterpart for, and preview code is presentation.
PoisonPower.cs:42 is `public int`, not `public override`, so the harness does not enumerate it and it has no dispatcher. Recorded so a reader does not think it was skipped.
